Regular watch brief minutes
The monthly meeting was held with Mateo Wilson, Maya Sato, Chester, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk team present.

The chair opened by thanking staff for steady handling of pet travel inquiries and for keeping guidance clear before departure. Discussion focused on reducing stress for travelers with animals by using plain language, confirming carrier requirements early, and checking that special care notes are passed without delay. Staff also reviewed recent customer feedback, which praised calm handling but asked for more consistent reminders on document readiness and cabin expectations.

The team discussed coordination with the airport desk so passengers receive the same advice at each contact point. <<FACT F051>> The meeting agreed that all replies should stay courteous, specific, and easy to follow, with added attention to families traveling with anxious pets.

The chair closed by noting that better consistency will support both passenger confidence and animal welfare. The meeting ended in orderly fashion.
